title: fix(app-shell,i18n): the Pending changes summary agrees each type with its count
body:
Fixes #13147
Clause-②: no

## What

The Studio's Pending changes summary read "2 items · 2 flow". Each type segment went through `preview.changes.summaryType` (`{{n}} {{type}}`), which takes the raw metadata type and no `count`, so i18next never chose a plural form.

- `DraftChangesPanel` now builds each segment with `summaryTypeSegment`. A known type reads through its own i18next count family, `preview.changes.typeCount.TYPE`, called with `count`. The keys are spelled out in a static `TYPE_COUNT` table, not built from the type, so no new dynamic key family is added.
- Known types: object, view, page, dashboard, app, action, report, flow, permission, agent, email_template.
- A type with no row keeps today's `summaryType` segment with its raw name, unpluralised (ruling 2).
- Each of the ten packs carries the families in the shape `all-locales-key-parity`, `plural-categories-11432` and `count-families-11445` already enforce. That means a base key plus `_one` / `_other`, `_many` in es, fr and pt, `_few` / `_many` in ru, and all six categories in ar. ja, ko and zh repeat one string across their slots.
- Every pack keeps its own word order: "2 flows" in en, "流程 2" in zh, "Потоки: 2" in ru, "تدفقات 2" in ar.
- The leading "N items" segment is unchanged.

## Tests

- New: `DraftChangesPanel.summaryPlural-13147.test.tsx`. It renders the panel against a real i18next instance and the shipped packs, with no `vi.mock`.
  - (a) Two flow drafts: "2 items · 2 flows".
  - (b) One flow and three views: "4 items · 1 flow · 3 views".
  - (c) zh, two flows: "2 项 · 流程 2".
  - (d) CONTROL: an unknown type `st_unknown_kind` reads "2 items · 2 st_unknown_kind".
- Updated: the confirm-posture pin in `DraftChangesPanel.posture-12517.test.tsx`. Its stubbed `t()` cannot plural-select, so it now pins the shape: "3 items", then one counted segment per type group. The words are pinned by the new file.
- Targeted run under the shared lock, `--maxWorkers=1`, at `2950dafcb4`: 19 files, 146 passed. The files are the 15 `DraftChangesPanel*.test.tsx` files plus `all-locales-key-parity`, `count-families-11445`, `plural-categories-11432` and `en-zh-key-parity`.
- Ablation via `ablation-replace.mjs`, with a trap restore. The anchor `summaryTypeSegment(t, type, items.length)` was swapped back to the count-blind `summaryType` call (anchor 1 to 0, blob `cd28897ee045` to `c1b04cca98d0`).
  - (a) went red: it received "2 items · 2 flow".
  - (b) went red: it received "4 items · 1 flow · 3 view".
  - (c) went red: it received "2 项 · flow 2".
  - The CONTROL (d) stayed green.
  - The restore was proven by blob hash: after restore `cd28897ee045` equals HEAD's `cd28897ee045`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates (at `2950dafcb4`)

- Closure build `@object-ui/app-shell^...`: exit 0.
- Type-check: `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`).
- Lint, narrowed to the 13 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (count read from `eslint --format json`): 0 errors, 6 warnings. The same 6 warnings are on `origin/main`'s `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, shifted by the inserted lines. Type-aware linting is not enabled, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Pre-tsc battery: all exit 0. That covers `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `i18n-dead-keys`, plus `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/i18n/` test directories.

## Acceptance notes

- The order's ruling 1 says to name the type the way the per-type headings do. On `origin/main` those headings print the raw `type` (uppercased by CSS), not a display name, so there was no display name to reuse. The count families add the display names. The headings themselves are not changed here.
- The translations follow each pack's existing nouns where the pack has them (the `commandPalette` rows); the rest are new wording a translator may refine.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13147-draft-summary-plural.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, `patch`.
